title: Damped oscillator λ
description: Essential: Correctly solves for λ as iΩ (or equivalent) from the guessed exponential solution.

title: Trajectory x(t) and y(t)
description: Essential: Provides final expressions for x(t) and y(t) as A cos(Ωt+φ) and A sin(Ωt+φ) respectively.

title: Heat equation dispersion
description: Important: Correctly derives the dispersion relation ω = -i a k² from the heat equation guess.

title: Schrödinger dispersion
description: Important: Correctly derives the dispersion relation ω = ħk²/(2m) from the Schrödinger equation.

title: Klein-Gordon dispersion
description: Important: Correctly derives the dispersion relation ω = ±√(k²c² + m²c⁴/ħ²) from the Klein-Gordon equation.

title: Complex exponential manipulation
description: Optional: Demonstrates correct use of Euler's formula to separate real and imaginary parts.

title: Sign or algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in solving for λ, ω, or in the exponent of the guessed solution.

title: Missing ± in dispersion
description: Pitfall: Omits the ± sign in the Klein-Gordon dispersion relation.
